= Backlog execution — round 65 (2026-11-07) =

== Completed in this pass ==

=== ACE `-2` archive-data CRC failure ===

The previously open diagnosis gate is closed for a representative failure class. The baseline `seb3773/ace-c` build and the Huffman-only patch reproduce an archive-data CRC mismatch on Delta-mode patterned inputs; carrying the four-entry LZ77 repeat-distance history across blocked tokenization runs fixes the mismatch when combined with the Huffman patch. The exact historical temporary fixture is still unknown, so this is not a bit-for-bit replay of it. The fix remains separate from CyberChef's ACE header CRC-16 check.

- Patch: `patches/ace-c-lz77-distance-history.patch`
- Regression: `scripts/test-ace-c-distance-history-fix.sh`
- Diagnosis and caveats: `docs/ace-delta-history-crc-fix-2026-11-07.md`
- Checks passed on 2026-11-07: distance-history regression (baseline `-z` control, baseline/Huffman-only failures, combined-patch test_core and three `-2` round trips); Huffman regression (14,150 cases, zero failures, five archive round trips).

=== CyberChef ElGamal recipe ===

Added `elgamalMulDemo`, a dedicated **ElGamal Multiplicative Homomorphism (not FHE)** recipe pack, and public Cookbook/README documentation. The operation uses explicit toy parameters; it samples no randomness and warns that it is insecure and not FHE. The default group/vector is independently checked with Python modular exponentiation and pinned in the test suite. Registry count and full-coverage tests were updated from 517 to 518; the Webxdc build synchronizes the merged kitchen.

- Implementation: `public/apps/cyberchef/index.html`
- Tests: `tests/cyberchef-elgamal-multiplicative.test.mjs`, plus updated cookbook and archive-registry tests
- Detailed source/vector scope: `docs/cyberchef-elgamal-multiplicative-demo-2026-11-07.md`

=== AGE and PGPony source/registry review ===

Created `docs/age-pgpony-local-recipe-review-2026-11-07.md`. It checks the current AGE spec against age v1.3.2 source and explicitly distinguishes recipient-form support from tagged identity/hardware support. It records upstream `age-inspect` classification tests, the current PGPonyAndroid/F-Droid/Kotlin-core sources, and the unresolved discrepancy between the PGPony open-source page and Kotlin-core README. No new AGE/PGPony operation or cipher code was added.
